healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Validate the Manus API key with GET /v2/project.list.

tasks.list.title: List tasks
tasks.list.description: List Manus tasks with optional cursor pagination and scope filters.

tasks.get.title: Get task
tasks.get.description: Retrieve one Manus task by ID.

tasks.create.title: Create task
tasks.create.description: Create a Manus task. The agent runs asynchronously.

locale.description: Output locale such as en or zh-CN.

tasks.update.title: Update task
tasks.update.description: Update a Manus task title or share visibility.

tasks.stop.title: Stop task
tasks.stop.description: Stop a running Manus task. A stopped task can still be resumed with tasks.sendMessage.

tasks.sendMessage.title: Send task message
tasks.sendMessage.description: Send a follow-up message to a Manus task.

tasks.listMessages.title: List task messages
tasks.listMessages.description: List event messages for a Manus task with optional cursor pagination.

projects.list.title: List projects
projects.list.description: List Manus projects in the current account.

projects.create.title: Create project
projects.create.description: Create a Manus project to group related tasks and shared instructions.

connectors.list.title: List connectors
connectors.list.description: List Manus connectors installed in the current account.

agents.list.title: List agents
agents.list.description: List Manus custom agents in the current account.

agents.get.title: Get agent
agents.get.description: Get details for one Manus custom agent.

agents.update.title: Update agent
agents.update.description: Update a Manus agent's nickname or description.

files.upload.title: Create file upload
files.upload.description: Create a Manus file record and return a presigned upload URL.

files.get.title: Get file
files.get.description: Retrieve a Manus file record, including a temporary download URL when available.

skills.list.title: List skills
skills.list.description: List installed Manus skills available for task selection.

webhooks.list.title: List webhooks
webhooks.list.description: List Manus webhook endpoints in the current account.

webhooks.create.title: Create webhook
webhooks.create.description: Create a Manus webhook that receives task lifecycle notifications.

usage.credits.get.title: Get available credits
usage.credits.get.description: Return the Manus credit balance and subscription refresh information for the caller.

user.me.title: Get current user
user.me.description: Return the Manus user ID associated with the authenticated API key.

v1.files.list.title: List files
v1.files.list.description: List the 10 most recently uploaded files with GET /v1/files.

v1.files.create.title: Create file
v1.files.create.description: Create a file record and presigned upload URL with POST /v1/files. The JSON body is filename only; the bytes are uploaded separately.

filename.description: Name of the file to upload.

v1.files.get.title: Get file
v1.files.get.description: Retrieve one file by ID with GET /v1/files/{{file_id}}.

v1.files.delete.title: Delete file
v1.files.delete.description: Delete a file record and its stored bytes with DELETE /v1/files/{{file_id}}.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return. Default 100, range 1-1000.

instruction.description: Default instruction applied to tasks in this project.

after.description: Cursor. ID of the last task from the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return. Default 100, range 1-1000.

query.description: Search term matched against title and body.

createdAfter.description: Return tasks created after this Unix timestamp in seconds.

createdBefore.description: Return tasks created before this Unix timestamp in seconds.

project_id.description: Return only tasks in this project.

prompt.description: Task prompt or instruction for the agent.

attachments.description: File or image attachments. Each item is a file id, a public URL, or base64 file data.

file_id.description: ID of a file created with POST /v1/files.

url.description: Publicly accessible URL of the file or image.

taskMode.description: Deprecated. Ignored by the API; tasks run in agent mode.

connectors.description: Connector IDs already configured on the account.

hideInTaskList.description: Hide this task from the Manus web app task list.

taskId.description: Existing task ID when continuing a multi-turn task.

locale.description: Locale such as en-US or zh-CN.

projectId.description: Project whose instruction applies to this task.

interactiveMode.description: Allow follow-up questions when the prompt is incomplete.

convert.description: Convert task output. Currently applies only to pptx files.

enableVisibleInTaskList.description: Show the task in the task list.

url.description: HTTPS URL that receives webhook requests.

v1.webhooks.publicKey.title: Get webhook public key
v1.webhooks.publicKey.description: Fetch the RSA-SHA256 webhook public key with GET /v1/webhook/public_key.
